Title: SkyeBrowse updates pricing with new tools for drone 3D mapping
Summary: SkyeBrowse has updated its pricing structure for its drone 3D mapping platform to better cater to the needs of users. The company has introduced three new plans, each designed to suit the specific use cases of teams that capture 3D models with drones. This move is intended to provide more flexibility and affordability for users.

Title: FrameTap just got better, and DJI Pocket 4P owners will notice
Summary: DJI's Osmo Pocket 4P firmware update simplifies the camera's use in real-world setups. The update improves the Osmo FrameTap accessory, making it more useful for users. FrameTap owners can now expect even more convenience from their tiny dual-lens camera.

Title: Lowe’s is now delivering tools by drone in as little as 20 minutes
Summary: Lowe's is launching a drone delivery pilot in Matthews, North Carolina, allowing customers to order a limited selection of tools and essentials in as little as 20 minutes through DoorDash. This makes Lowe's the first home improvement retailer in the US to offer drone delivery. The service is currently available to DIY customers and professionals.

Title: Drone pilots can now analyze crashes and count crowds with SkyeBrowse app
Summary: Drones can now analyze crashes and count crowds in seconds, thanks to the SkyeBrowse app's new AI-powered workflows. The app's Crush Analysis and Claims feature helps with vehicle crash investigations and insurance work, while the Crowd Counter feature estimates the number of people in an aerial image. SkyeBrowse's Crowd Counter is also now available directly through the DJI RC Pro for enterprise drone operations.

Title: Flytrex wants its delivery drones waiting before you even order food
Summary: Flytrex is addressing the challenge of getting food from restaurants to delivery drones on time by pre-positioning the drones at the restaurants before orders are taken. This aims to minimize the time spent preparing food for delivery, thereby improving the efficiency of drone-based delivery services.

Title: Skydio unveils F10, MegaDock and software for autonomous drone fleets
Summary: Skydio is launching a new line of products to support the growing trend of autonomous drone fleets, including the F10 drone, MegaDock charging station, and software designed to manage these fleets. The company envisions drones being used in emergency response, infrastructure inspection, and property surveillance with minimal human intervention. This move suggests a shift away from consumer-focused camera drones and toward more specialized, industrial applications.

Title: Elroy Air secures fresh funding to scale Chaparral drone production
Summary: Elroy Air has secured $175 million in funding to scale its production of its autonomous cargo drone, Chaparral. The additional funding, part of a private investment in public equity (PIPE), is led by existing backers including Lockheed Martin Ventures and Inflection Point. This brings the total funding to $75 million ahead of the planned business combination with Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII.

Title: Insta360 cameras can now turn your videos into explorable 3D worlds
Summary: Insta360 cameras can now transform videos into immersive 3D worlds, allowing users to explore a captured space from different angles. This technology enables a more engaging experience, moving beyond the limitations of traditional photo or video formats. The new feature is available on Insta360 cameras.

Title: Neros Wins $100M Pentagon Order, Plus 800 Drones Rivals Didn't Deliver
Summary: Neros has secured a $100M Pentagon order for its Gauntlet II drones, totaling 14,000 units. Additionally, the company claims to have acquired 800 drones from rivals that failed to meet their delivery deadlines.

Title: LexisNexis Names Valqari the No. 3 Most Innovative Drone Startup in the World
Summary: Valqari, a company developing fully autonomous drone delivery infrastructure, has been named the world's third most innovative drone startup by LexisNexis. This recognition is a testament to the company's pioneering work in the rapidly evolving drone industry. The company aims to transform the delivery landscape with its autonomous drone technology.

Title: A new pulley system is changing how cleaning drones work
Summary: Lucid Bots has developed a new pulley system for its Sherpa cleaning drone, allowing it to distribute the weight of its cleaning hose across a rooftop structure, reducing the strain on the aircraft. This innovation enables the Sherpa to clean taller buildings more efficiently.

Title: Drone Incursions at Wildfires Surge as Aircraft Face More Groundings
Summary: Unauthorized drone flights are increasing, disrupting wildfire aerial firefighting operations, and prompting enforcement efforts. The surge in drone incursions is putting a strain on firefighting efforts during the ongoing severe wildfire season in the western U.S. Authorities are taking steps to address the issue.

Title: FBI's Balloon Fiesta No Drone Zone Runs On A Clock: 10.5 Hours A Day
Summary: The FBI's counter-drone teams are enforcing a no-drone zone at the Balloon Fiesta, but the enforcement periods are only 5.5 hours long. The Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) notices to airmen (NOTAMs) only cover the 5.5-hour periods.

Title: When a Drone Flies Overhead, Are We Creating a Threat Where There Isn’t One?
Summary: The Finnish Real Estate Federation has urged housing companies to assess potential risks associated with drones flying overhead, as concerns arise about the potential for increased surveillance and threat to privacy. Some argue that drones are not a significant threat, while others believe that their presence could create a new security risk. The industry is left to weigh the benefits of drone technology against the potential risks it poses.
